note: Synthetic demo table (I1), deliberately incomplete (I7): a missing key means no_data, never 'no interaction' (I4). Key = GENE:phenotype|drug, plus |dose>Nmg when dose-conditioned (CONTRACTS.md).

rules.source: CPIC guideline for CYP2C19 genotype and clopidogrel therapy (2022 update)
rules.text: CYP2C19 poor metabolizers convert clopidogrel to its active form poorly, so it may protect less after a stent. The guideline suggests the prescriber consider an alternative antiplatelet.

rules.source: CPIC guideline for CYP2C19 genotype and clopidogrel therapy (2022 update)
rules.text: CYP2C19 intermediate metabolizers activate clopidogrel less than usual. The guideline suggests the prescriber consider an alternative antiplatelet after a stent.

rules.source: CPIC guideline for SLCO1B1, ABCG2 and CYP2C9 genotypes and statin-associated musculoskeletal symptoms (2022)
rules.text: Decreased SLCO1B1 function raises simvastatin blood levels and the risk of muscle problems, more so above 20 mg a day. Worth asking the prescriber about the dose or another statin.

rules.source: CPIC guideline for SLCO1B1, ABCG2 and CYP2C9 genotypes and statin-associated musculoskeletal symptoms (2022)
rules.text: Poor SLCO1B1 function greatly raises simvastatin blood levels and the risk of muscle problems. The guideline suggests the prescriber consider another statin.
